lesson.sentenceEn: The class ends at two o'clock.

continuityPolicy.entryFrameRule: scene-1 uses approved keyframe-01; scene-n uses previous scene final frame
continuityPolicy.poseTargetRule: approved keyframes are the target pose cards for each 6-second clip

brief.targetViewer: English-speaking beginner Korean learner who wants one fast classroom sentence plus a light self-check before the short ends.
brief.whyClickNow: Learn one useful Korean classroom sentence in under 30 seconds, then confirm that you remember the key word with a blank recall beat.
brief.viewerPromise: The viewer learns the word for class through a real sentence tied to a simple time expression instead of an isolated flashcard.
brief.angle: Use a school-specific sentence with a clear time marker so the lesson feels practical, easy to repeat, and easy to recall.
hookOptions: Learn one Korean classroom sentence in 30 seconds
Hear it, repeat it, then check yourself
Today's quick Korean lesson with Daehan
proofPlan: Introduce the full sentence early so the lesson promise pays off fast.
Use a repeat beat to move the viewer from passive watching to speaking along.
Convert the same sentence into a blank recall in scene-4 to prove retention.
brief.packagingRule: Title, thumbnail, and opening frame must promise a fast classroom Korean lesson with an end-of-short recall check, not a misleading blind quiz.
brief.engagementCopy: Double tap if you know it.

scenes.goal: Open with the standard Daehan greeting beat and establish a friendly classroom lesson tone.
Introduce the full sentence and focus the viewer on the classroom meaning plus time expression.
Give the viewer a repeat-along beat so the full sentence sticks.
Switch the lesson into a blank recall check using the same sentence.
Close with a short service CTA and warm farewell wave.

productionNotes.referenceResolution: Use daehan canon for visual identity and use 003 only for structure, timing, and ending posture.
productionNotes.openingReusePolicy: Reuse the proven greeting cadence and lesson-host posture, but do not import the 2D pilot render style.
productionNotes.endingTreatment: Keep scene-5 as a generated farewell shot plus downstream dub and typography; no fixed ending asset is required at brief stage.
productionNotes.romanizationSourceNote: Use the fallback romanization locked in source-packet.json only as helper copy because source reading data was not reliable.

notes.downstreamGuardrail: Do not change the source sentence, switch to 2D pilot styling, or introduce visible text during generation.
